"This chart illustrates the **Gross Financing Needs (as a percentage of GDP)** over a period from 2019 to 2029.

### Chart Components
*   **Vertical Axis (Y-axis):** Represents percentage of GDP, ranging from 0 to 40 in increments of 10.
*   **Horizontal Axis (X-axis):** Represents years from 2019 to 2029.
*   **Legend/Series:**
    *   **Financing provided by banks:** Dark blue vertical bars (starting in 2025).
    *   **Actual:** Solid red line (2019–2023).
    *   **Baseline:** Dashed red line (2024–2029).
    *   **Stress scenario:** Dotted black line (2024–2029).
    *   **Pink/Purple Line:** (Per context, represents Contingent Liabilities scenario) Solid pink line branching from the baseline after 2023.

### Data Table (Estimated Values)

Values are approximate based on the visual position against the Y-axis.

| Year | Actual (Solid Red) | Baseline (Dashed Red) | Contingent Liab. (Pink) | Stress Scenario (Dotted Black) | Bank Financing (Blue Bar) |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **2019** | 15 | | | | |
| **2020** | 20 | | | | |
| **2021** | 18 | | | | |
| **2022** | 16.5 | | | | |
| **2023** | 9 | | | | |
| **2024** | | 3 | 3 | 3 | |
| **2025** | | 15 | 18.5 | 16 | 2 |
| **2026** | | 7 | 7.5 | 16.5 | 4 |
| **2027** | | 11.5 | 14 | 17.5 | 4.5 |
| **2028** | | 8 | 9 | 18.5 | 5.5 |
| **2029** | | 9.5 | 11 | 18.5 | 5.5 |

### Summary of Trends
*   **Actual Data (2019-2023):** Financing needs peaked in 2020 at 20% of GDP and declined significantly to approximately 9% by 2023.
*   **Projections (2024-2029):** All scenarios show a sharp drop to roughly 3% in 2024 before rebounding. 
*   **Scenarios:** The "Stress scenario" remains consistently high (between 16% and 18.5%) from 2025 onward. The "Baseline" and "Contingent Liabilities" scenarios show higher volatility, with a significant spike in 2025 and another smaller peak in 2027.
*   **Bank Financing:** Provided financing from banks is projected to start at 2% in 2025 and gradually increase to 5.5% by 2029."
